description.En: The trace becomes noticeably less fuzzy. The random spikes of the noise floor start to settle down, revealing more consistent signals.
description.Fr: The trace becomes noticeably less fuzzy. The random spikes of the noise floor start to settle down, revealing more consistent signals.
description.De: The trace becomes noticeably less fuzzy. The random spikes of the noise floor start to settle down, revealing more consistent signals.
description.Es: The trace becomes noticeably less fuzzy. The random spikes of the noise floor start to settle down, revealing more consistent signals.

description.En: A good balance of noise reduction and display speed. The noise floor is clean, and low-level, stable signals are clearly visible.
description.Fr: A good balance of noise reduction and display speed. The noise floor is clean, and low-level, stable signals are clearly visible.
description.De: A good balance of noise reduction and display speed. The noise floor is clean, and low-level, stable signals are clearly visible.
description.Es: A good balance of noise reduction and display speed. The noise floor is clean, and low-level, stable signals are clearly visible.

description.En: The noise floor is now very stable and appears as a thin line. You're only seeing the most consistent signals and cutting out most of the random interference.
description.Fr: The noise floor is now very stable and appears as a thin line. You're only seeing the most consistent signals and cutting out most of the random interference.
description.De: The noise floor is now very stable and appears as a thin line. You're only seeing the most consistent signals and cutting out most of the random interference.
description.Es: The noise floor is now very stable and appears as a thin line. You're only seeing the most consistent signals and cutting out most of the random interference.

description.En: This setting is for serious analysis. It's a highly stable trace that filters out a large portion of the ambient RF noise, allowing for precise measurements of continuous signals.
description.Fr: This setting is for serious analysis. It's a highly stable trace that filters out a large portion of the ambient RF noise, allowing for precise measurements of continuous signals.
description.De: This setting is for serious analysis. It's a highly stable trace that filters out a large portion of the ambient RF noise, allowing for precise measurements of continuous signals.
description.Es: This setting is for serious analysis. It's a highly stable trace that filters out a large portion of the ambient RF noise, allowing for precise measurements of continuous signals.

description.En: For when only the cleanest signal will do. This high level of averaging provides a virtually noise-free display, perfect for scientific or very low-level signal detection.
description.Fr: For when only the cleanest signal will do. This high level of averaging provides a virtually noise-free display, perfect for scientific or very low-level signal detection.
description.De: For when only the cleanest signal will do. This high level of averaging provides a virtually noise-free display, perfect for scientific or very low-level signal detection.
description.Es: For when only the cleanest signal will do. This high level of averaging provides a virtually noise-free display, perfect for scientific or very low-level signal detection.

description.En: A deep and thorough look at the spectrum. All but the most stable signals are averaged out, offering a truly pristine view of the fundamental RF environment.
description.Fr: Un regard profond et complet sur le spectre. Tous les signaux, sauf les plus stables, sont moyennés, offrant une vue vraiment pure de l'environnement RF fondamental.
description.De: Ein tiefer und gründlicher Blick auf das Spektrum. Bis auf die stabilsten Signale werden alle gemittelt, was einen wirklich unverfälschten Blick auf die grundlegende HF-Umgebung bietet.
description.Es: Una mirada profunda y exhaustiva al espectro. Todas las señales, excepto las más estables, se promedian, ofreciendo una vista verdaderamente prístina del entorno de RF fundamental.

description.En: An incredibly slow and deliberate pace. This is for long-term monitoring, allowing you to see the overall shape of the spectrum with almost all noise removed.
description.Fr: Un rythme incroyablement lent et délibéré. Ceci est pour une surveillance à long terme, vous permettant de voir la forme globale du spectre avec presque tout le bruit supprimé.
description.De: Ein unglaublich langsames und bewusstes Tempo. Dies ist für die Langzeitüberwachung gedacht und ermöglicht es Ihnen, die Gesamtform des Spektrums zu sehen, wobei fast alle Störungen entfernt wurden.
description.Es: Un ritmo increíblemente lento y deliberado. Esto es para el monitoreo a largo plazo, permitiéndole ver la forma general del espectro con casi todo el ruido eliminado.

description.En: For the patient and the meticulous. This is the ultimate level of noise reduction, yielding an exceptionally smooth and stable trace for the most demanding analysis.
